before: No website of its own: a search leads to a social page or a directory listing
Hours, address and what you offer are spread across other people's sites
The first thing a new customer sees is not something the business controls
after: A site the business owns, at its own address
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room to add a menu, photos and news as the owner supplies them
